common_name: Real Goldcup Leucanthemum (Yellow-Flowered Realflor Shasta Daisy)

planting.note: Plant divisions or container-grown plants in spring or fall; Real Goldcup breaks from the usual white-petaled Shasta daisy palette with golden-yellow rays.

directions: Real Goldcup is a Realflor-series Shasta daisy bred for warm golden-yellow ray flowers instead of the white blooms typical of most Leucanthemum cultivars, flowering in repeat flushes from spring through fall on an upright, clump-forming plant. Its narrower, more vertical habit than older Shasta daisy strains keeps it from flopping in mixed borders, and shearing back spent flower stems encourages another round of bloom. Give it full sun to light afternoon shade and sharply drained soil, since like other Shasta daisies it declines quickly in heavy, waterlogged ground. It is reliably cold hardy, draws bees and butterflies, and is largely left alone by deer.
sources: Southern Living Plant Collection (southernlivingplants.com) — Real Goldcup Leucanthemum plant page
